newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Bucharest bourse to get new listing.
newsitem.headline: Bucharest bourse to get new listing.

text.p: The Bucharest stock exchange said on Tuesday the number of its listings would rise to 35 this week, when a new company joins in trading.
The newcomer is Navlomar SA ship agent and broker, which will start being traded on Wednesday May 7, a bourse statement said.

Navlomar, based in Bucharest, has a share capital of around 6.8 billion lei, in shares with a nominal value of 25,000 lei each. Navlomar employees hold a 55.007 percent stake, the State Ownership Fund has 29.993 percent and other stockholders have 15 percent.

Navlomar's plans for the future include purchase of two new ships, creation of a joint venture with a foreign partner and organisation of container shipment services in the Black Sea port of Constanta, the statement said.
The new stock joins the bourse's second tier, which now trades 30 companies. Another four stocks are listed on the first tier.
Brokers were unimpressed with the newcomer, saying its liquidity was too low to influence overall trading. ($=7,092 lei)
